notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Phantom Steed.
easyPrerequisites: Shipwreck Dowser is exiled by Phantom Steed.
description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one
Declare Phantom Steed as an attacker. It triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser that's tapped and attacking.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second extra turn.
